commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=7601f0beb95d27b2bf2360b760355c3c235871a1; git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git diff --check; echo STAGE28E_C_EXIT_EXACT_SHA_PASS=$EXPECTED

set -euo pipefail; test -f docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq '743369 B' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq '5296 B' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq '4736 B' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq '217444 B' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq '216808 B' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq '176128 B' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq '65.8 W' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq 'Phase C therefore passes its measurement/baseline criteria' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md; echo STAGE28E_C_EXIT_DOCS_EVIDENCE_PASS

set -euo pipefail; grep -Fq 'Phase D next' docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md; grep -Fq 'docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md' docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md; grep -Fq 'Phase D next' docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md; grep -Fq 'docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_C_HANDOFF.md' docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md; grep -Fq 'Do not reduce stacks or move FreeRTOS allocations to PSRAM until Phase E' docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md; echo STAGE28E_C_EXIT_GATE_PASS
